DOCKET NO. NNH-CV26-6023871-S : SUPERIOR COURT              
                                                                                    
                           TERRENCE OKONKWO : J.D. OF NEW HAVEN                     
                                    V. : AT NEW HAVEN                               
                                                                                    
                   BRIGHTLINE LOGISTICS, INC. AND SOFIA MARQUES : APRIL 21, 2026    
                                                                                    
                                                                                    
           COMPLAINT                                                                
                                                                                    
           1. The Plaintiff, Terrence Okonkwo, resides at 312 Quinnipiac Avenue, Apartment 3B, New Haven,
           Connecticut 06513.                                                       
           2. The Defendant Brightline Logistics, Inc. is a Connecticut corporation with a principal place of
                                                                                    
           business at 900 Boston Post Road, Milford, Connecticut 06460, and at all relevant times owned the box
           truck operated by the Defendant Sofia Marques, its employee.             
           3. On January 9, 2026, at approximately 7:15 a.m., the Plaintiff was operating his own 2017 Toyota
           Camry northbound on Interstate 91 near Exit 8 in New Haven, slowing for congested traffic.
                                                                                    
           4. The Defendant Marques, operating the Brightline box truck northbound behind the Plaintiff, failed to
           slow and struck the rear of the Plaintiff's vehicle, pushing it into the vehicle ahead.
           5. As a result the Plaintiff sustained a concussion with loss of consciousness; a fracture of the left
           clavicle; a lumbar strain with L4-L5 disc bulge; lacerations to the scalp requiring sutures; and bilateral
                                                                                    
           knee contusions.                                                         
           6. The Plaintiff was transported by ambulance to Yale New Haven Hospital, where he was admitted and
           remained hospitalized from January 9 through January 11, 2026.           
                                                                                    
           7. The Plaintiff has treated with Dr. Helena Voss, M.D., orthopaedic surgeon, of Shoreline
           Orthopaedics, 2200 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518; with Dr. Samuel Reyes-Okafor, M.D.,
           neurologist, of New Haven Neurology Group, 60 Temple Street, Suite 5C, New Haven, CT 06510; and
           with Elm City Rehabilitation, 455 State Street, New Haven, CT 06510.     
           8. The Plaintiff continues to suffer headaches, difficulty concentrating, low back pain, and reduced
                                                                                    
           range of motion of the left shoulder, and has not recovered.             
                                                                                    
           WHEREFORE, the Plaintiff claims money damages in excess of $15,000.      
                                                                                    
           THE PLAINTIFF, TERRENCE OKONKWO                                          
           By: Attorney Dana L. Whitcomb, Juris No. 433108                          
           Whitcomb Law Group LLC, 59 Elm Street, New Haven, CT 06510
